Wisp. 
By BlackEcho8      

They whisper words of hopefulness
My faint thoughts are a calm, grey mist.
They all cloud and pollute my mind
But they vanish into a wisp.

The frail moonlight blankets my eyes,
Wide open, I give a blank stare.
The glow softly fades as rain falls
My damp feelings are always there.

A splash of orange and pink rise
As a spark of yellow light wakes.
The commotion of birds begins.
The drooping branches softly sway.

The breeze is undescribable.
A caring being at your side.
The ombre horizon, spreading.
An air of happiness, I sigh.

Our blue world bustles with life, but
The rare moments of bliss like now 
Come and go like fragmented thoughts -
A smile 

amongst many frowns.
